other_conditions: The industrial unit must have made the investment on or after 1st April 2017.
At least 60% of the total employment in the unit must be provided to people of the Union Territory of Puducherry and this proportion must be maintained for the period specified in the affidavit.
The unit must directly employ a minimum of 10 persons.
All workers must be covered under the Provident Fund (PF).
The unit must not transfer or dispose of any fixed assets, including plant and machinery, for five years from the date of application submission or subsidy disbursement, whichever is later.

If two or more industrial undertakings are set up by the same proprietor, common partners, or common board of directors/shareholders, they are eligible as separate entities provided they are located at different sites and have separate licenses/clearances/registrations.
Eligibility category noted in source: Micro
Eligibility category noted in source: Small
Eligibility category noted in source: Medium
Eligibility category noted in source: Large
benefits_summary: A wage/employment subsidy of 20% of wages up to ₹5,00,000 per annum, payable over a period of up to five years.
